context_files.purpose: Project-level architecture-deliberation, human-ratification, independent-review, and GPU-gate contract.
Verbatim human intent concerning a minimal two-system assay, reconstructed context as state, memory compilation, and CompilerGym.
Normative v6 assay protocol whose scientific validity, feasibility, claim boundary, visibility rules, and tests are interpreted.
Validation requirements for schema conformance, exact proposal binding, context hashes, unique identifiers, and exact acceptance-test coverage.

system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal is a deliberately narrow first-life engineering assay of one frozen success-filtered action-cloning recipe in CompilerGym. It operationalizes context reconstruction as the only per-call conscious state, an eight-record success memory as bounded life state, and two cumulative LoRA rebuilds as the only learned substrate. This is a useful constructibility probe for the broader experiential-learning thesis only if recipe completion, behavioral contrasts, and scientific evidence are kept separate. One deterministic life on eight acquisition and four syntactically held-out targets cannot establish general learning efficacy, an experiential mechanism, autonomous context selection, an outcome model, functional compiler correctness, lifelong improvement, or superiority. A clean negative or positive contrast is diagnostic of these exact bytes and realized history, not a thesis verdict. The strict isolation from organism_v6 is scientifically necessary to prevent exploratory leakage and researcher degrees of freedom.
graph_delta_interpretation: The causal/dataflow graph adds two nominally matched on-policy lives, H and E, through a common controller/model/environment path; only E sends committed successful acquisition packets and canonical action targets to a sleep compiler and clean-base LoRA trainer after tasks 4 and 8. The published E adapter returns to later E inference, while ordinary bounded snapshots carry explicit life and memory state. Final targets fork into H, E_ON, and E_OFF, with receipts quarantined until all cells terminate and an offline auditor reports. Scientifically important colliders and mediators must remain explicit: success-filter admission is selected by observed improvement; the first E adapter changes later E actions, observations, memory, and second-sleep rows; therefore final H-versus-E_ON bundles adapter plus divergent endogenous history. E_ON-versus-E_OFF holds the realized E snapshot fixed and isolates the operational mount change on the finite panel, but the protocol appropriately refuses population or mechanism language. The declared H/E byte-exact pre-sleep parity is currently ill-posed for whole canonical events and snapshots because their required system field is H versus E; tests must compare a declared projection or permit exactly that identity field to differ.
loop_delta_interpretation: Each task is a six-step closed compiler interaction loop reconstructed cold at every slot from system text plus canonical current state; there is no provider-history or KV-state carryover. Memory admission is immediate, local, and success-filtered. E then has an outer developmental loop: four tasks, cumulative clean-base adapter rebuild, four more tasks under the first adapter, cumulative clean-base rebuild, and frozen held-out forks. This is two coupled loops rather than evidence for distinct conscious and subconscious cognitive processes: the same base model is used for action generation, while deterministic supervised optimization compiles selected successful actions. The design is operationally auditable but scientifically path-dependent. After sleep 1, E's policy affects what examples are available for sleep 2, so the second adapter is not an independent replication and cannot identify the marginal value of the second sleep. Feasibility is plausible but not established by specification: at the structural maximum there are 24 selected rows at sleep 1 and 48 at sleep 2, producing 576, 1,152, and another 1,152 single-sample updates for sleep-1 build, final build A, and comparison build B. A 32B model at up to 4,096 tokens on one GH200 may be memory-feasible with LoRA, but wall-clock, activation-memory, kernel determinism, and atomic-storage margins require manifest-bound evidence before the indivisible one-shot authorization; no scientific conclusion follows from merely surviving those constraints.
claim_delta_interpretation: The only defensible terminal claim is either that the exact bound recipe completed under all integrity gates and produced the reported finite-panel descriptive curves and contrasts, or that it ended with the first-applicable INDETERMINATE/INTEGRITY_FAILURE disposition. RECIPE_COMPLETE is independent of the signs of D_HE and D_ONOFF. D_HE is a whole-system descriptive contrast confounded by post-sleep policy, environment trajectory, success-selected training data, and bounded memory divergence. D_ONOFF is a controlled operational mount contrast conditional on one realized E history and four fixed targets, but without replication or a sampling design it cannot support population, efficacy, or mechanism claims. F uses instruction-count improvement normalized by the Oz gap, can exceed one, and is neither functional correctness nor a calibrated utility measure. The hash split is only syntactic holdout: distinct source/bitcode hashes do not prove semantic independence or exclude near-duplicate programs. With n=4 fixed targets and one deterministic life, there is no valid p-value, confidence interval, generalization estimate, saturation curve, or paper-level claim. Success filtering also makes the learned object behavior cloning of immediately improving actions; it gives no evidence for learning outcomes, failures, temporal credit, principles, rationales, counterfactuals, private thought, creativity, or intelligent sleep.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The scientific validity of the assay depends on noninterference, not merely prompt redaction. Model calls may see only the frozen system text and one canonical packet containing hashed task identity, frozen/current life counters, slot budget, counts, current observation, within-task history, and bounded successful memory. They must not see raw URI/role, system or adapter condition labels, receipts, future tasks, provider history, raw prior responses, private reasoning, quarantine output, or wall-time/process cues. The sealer must be model-blind and action-blind; the parser must be outcome-blind; the memory writer must be target- and adapter-blind; the trainer must be environment-, target-, H-, and quarantine-blind; target launching must be result-blind; collection must be model/environment/life-blind; and reporting starts only after the sealed teardown barrier. Capability denial must cover indirect channels as well as declared files: environment variables, argv/cwd, inherited descriptors, stdout/stderr routing, service endpoints, network, caches, timestamps, filenames, mount topology, and process reuse. The finite audited-surface qualifier is essential: passing evidence supports only 'no forbidden access found on enumerated surfaces,' never a global absence claim.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V6S6_T01_STATE_PACKET_TRANSITION_GOLDENS must reject any noncanonical JSON, hash, counter, history, memory, event, malformed/no-op/rejection state drift, overflow, truncation, retry, or task-budget behavior and must demonstrate structural maxima and actual token bounds rather than assume them. It must cover improving, worsening, rejected, malformed, and deliberate-no-op transitions, eviction order, task/sleep/event counters, F arithmetic, first-applicable dispositions, and a declared projection resolving the impossible literal equality of H/E artifacts that carry different system fields. V6S6_T02_SAMPLE_WRITER_BUILD_GOLDENS must prove exact success-filter admission, decoded-packet hash binding, canonical targets, row-ID deduplication and order, chat-template prefix/suffix equality, label masks, copy/update counts, clean-base starts, finite tensors, inventory comparisons, build-A/build-B tolerances, destruction of transient trainer state, atomic publication, and authentic-build-only mounting; zero eligible rows must be INDETERMINATE rather than silently changing the recipe. V6S6_T03_CAPABILITY_LIFECYCLE_QUARANTINE_GOLDENS must adversarially deny every unlisted actor capability, including indirect process/file/network/cache channels, and prove cold target forks, same-snapshot E_ON/E_OFF identity, no cross-cell result flow or retry, quarantine until complete teardown, exact barrier behavior, isolated-cell failure handling, and reporter activation only after the barrier. Passing supports only the finite audited-surface claim. V6S6_T04_CPU_DOUBLE_SEAL must run exactly two cold CPU-only no-model sealers and establish byte-identical manifests and rejection ledgers, exact seed/URI ordering, rejection precedence, hash uniqueness, two-process reset determinism, fixed acquisition/target selection, unchanged local CompilerGym bytes, and absence of model/Fable/result-dependent selection. V6S6_T05_EXACT_PRE_GPU_REVIEW must bind a closed manifest and have a fresh independent reviewer with veto plus an author advocate inspect the exact implementation, tests, receipts, audited surface, model/runtime identities, tokenizer/packet limits, single-GH200 resource envelope, and claim language before any model access or GPU authorization. Advocate agreement cannot cure an independent rejection, and the review must not authorize anything beyond one later human-ratified indivisible run. V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE must be a fresh post-run recomputation from immutable actual receipts of every packet, slot, projected parity fact, memory/snapshot transition, selected row, label mask, update, tensor comparison, mount, teardown, target cell, quarantine barrier, F/D value, and first-applicable disposition, with no repair or rerun. The protocol's differently spelled V6S_T06 label must be reconciled before ratification. All six tests are integrity/conformance gates; none converts a four-target deterministic assay into an inferential study or permits result-contingent claim expansion.
assumptions: The later manifest binds a single exact 32B base model and a context cap of at least 4,128 tokens, but neither ratification nor implementation is yet authorized by this interpretation.
CompilerGym service acceptance means the requested catalog pass completed according to the pinned service; it is not treated as proof of semantic equivalence or functional correctness.
The four target programs are a fixed hash-selected panel rather than a probability sample from a scientifically defined deployment population.
Any reported mean uses only determinate cells exactly as the eventually ratified reporting contract specifies; missing-cell handling may not be invented after outcomes are visible.
Build A/B tolerance is an integrity reproducibility threshold for this stack, not a statistical uncertainty estimate.
No organism_v6 artifact, observation, threshold, failure, or result informed this interpretation or may inform the assay except independently authored synthetic bug fixtures as explicitly allowed.

ambiguities.question: Does pre-sleep 'exact match' mean byte equality after removing only the mandatory system identity field, or is a different canonical comparison object intended for H/E events and snapshots?
ambiguities.impact: Literal byte equality is impossible because canonical H and E events/snapshots contain different system values. Without a frozen projection, a central contamination check is either unsatisfiable or vulnerable to post hoc interpretation.

ambiguities.question: If one isolated target cell fails and the disposition is INDETERMINATE after the barrier, are F, D_HE, and D_ONOFF suppressed entirely, reported with explicit missing cells only, or recomputed on a predeclared complete-case subset?
ambiguities.impact: Unspecified missing-cell handling creates a result-dependent reporting choice and could make the two contrasts incomparable or misleading.

ambiguities.question: What manifest-bound peak-memory, storage, and worst-case wall-clock evidence is required before authorizing up to 2,880 single-sample 32B LoRA updates plus inference in one indivisible GH200 run?
ambiguities.impact: A technically valid but under-resourced recipe can fail before scientific observation, and the no-canary/no-rerun rule makes an unquantified feasibility risk especially costly.

ambiguities.question: Which exact signed-64-bit arithmetic rules govern d_i, I0-best_count, per-task F, and mean/difference accumulation so overflow, floating conversion, and reporter agreement are deterministic?
ambiguities.impact: The inputs are bounded integers but subtraction can overflow signed 64-bit arithmetic, and unspecified float/reduction semantics can cause cross-implementation disposition or report disagreement.

ambiguities.question: Will the final report expose source/bitcode duplicate and reset checks while explicitly labeling unresolved semantic relatedness among acquisition and target programs?
ambiguities.impact: Readers may otherwise overinterpret hash uniqueness as semantic out-of-distribution generalization.

ambiguities.question: Is the protocol's V6S_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE spelling intended to denote the proposal's authoritative V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE acceptance test?
ambiguities.impact: Unreconciled identifiers can cause the manifest, implementation, reviewers, and intake validator to bind different nominal gates despite similar prose.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The requirement that H and E events and memory snapshots match exactly during tasks 1-4 is not satisfiable for complete canonical bytes as written.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Both artifact schemas include a required system field whose value is H for one life and E for the other. That intended identity difference necessarily changes bytes and snapshot/event hashes even when every scientifically relevant input and outcome is matched.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, define a canonical parity projection that excludes exactly the system identity field, compare all remaining fields and referenced packet/response bytes exactly, and require T01/T04/T06 to recompute both the projected equality and the expected identity-only difference.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: B1/B2 and manifest review are not yet explicit enough about quantitative single-GH200 feasibility for the indivisible no-canary run.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: At maximum row admission the recipe schedules 2,880 optimizer steps across three 32B LoRA builds, potentially at 4,096 tokens per sample, in addition to cold inference and duplicate final builds. Model fit alone does not establish activation headroom, deterministic-kernel support, storage headroom, or completion time.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require B2 evidence, bound before run authorization and obtained without learned actions, that computes worst-case tensor/optimizer/activation/storage budgets and a conservative wall-clock envelope for the exact model, sequence lengths, kernels, and GH200. Treat insufficient margin as pre-authorization rejection, not an in-run scientific result.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The protocol permits an isolated target-cell failure but does not freeze how descriptive contrasts are handled when the 3-by-4 panel is incomplete.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Computing a contrast from condition-specific surviving cells, silently dropping a task, or suppressing all metrics answer different questions. Choosing after receipts are released creates avoidable analysis flexibility.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind before target access that any missing cell makes both aggregate D values unavailable while preserving raw determinate cell curves and an explicit missing-cell map, or bind another single exact rule with paired-task denominators and no post hoc choice. Make T05 and T06 enforce it.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The protocol names the post-run gate V6S_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE, while the architecture proposal and intake validator require V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Exact artifact binding is a core integrity property. Near-matching identifiers are not interchangeable and could leave the later manifest or review outside the acceptance-test chain.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Amend the proposed protocol bytes before human ratification so every occurrence uses the authoritative V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE identifier, then regenerate and rebind downstream artifacts.

open_questions: Will Rohin ratify an exact identity-field parity projection so the H/E pre-sleep contamination check is satisfiable and non-negotiable?
What exact missing-cell reporting rule will be frozen before any target result can exist?
What quantitative memory, storage, determinism, and wall-clock margins must the one closed manifest demonstrate for the single-GH200 indivisible run?
Will the protocol and proposal be revised to use one exact V6S6_T06_ACTUAL_RUN_CONFORMANCE identifier throughout?

Does ratification accept that RECIPE_COMPLETE supports only exact-byte descriptive reporting, regardless of D signs, with every efficacy, causal, cognitive, functional-correctness, lifelong, and paper claim forbidden?

Does the authorized scope remain limited to isolated v6simple implementation, synthetic/mock fixtures, and two cold CPU-only no-model sealer invocations until a later separate exact-manifest ratification?
